Title: Pride and Prejudice
Author: Jane Austen
Summary: Elizabeth Bennet trades sharp remarks with the proud Mr Darcy while her family navigates marriage, money and reputation.

Title: Moby-Dick
Author: Herman Melville
Summary: Ishmael signs on to a whaling ship whose captain is consumed by his hunt for a white whale.

Title: Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus
Author: Mary Shelley
Summary: A young scientist gives life to a creature and then abandons it, with tragic consequences for both.

Title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
Author: Lewis Carroll
Summary: Alice follows a white rabbit down a hole into a world of riddles, nonsense and peculiar logic.

Title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
Author: Arthur Conan Doyle
Summary: Twelve cases solved by the famous consulting detective and narrated by his friend Dr Watson.

Title: Dracula
Author: Bram Stoker
Summary: Told through letters and diaries, a group of friends confront an ancient count who has come to England.

Title: War and Peace
Author: Leo Tolstoy
Summary: Several aristocratic families live through the Napoleonic invasion of Russia.

Title: Don Quixote
Author: Miguel de Cervantes
Summary: A country gentleman who has read too many chivalric romances sets out as a knight with his squire Sancho Panza.

Title: Metamorphosis
Author: Franz Kafka
Summary: A travelling salesman wakes up transformed into a giant insect and becomes a burden to his family.

Title: The Time Machine
Author: H. G. Wells
Summary: An inventor travels to the distant future and finds humanity split into two strange species.

Title: Les Misérables
Author: Victor Hugo
Summary: The former convict Jean Valjean seeks redemption while being pursued by the relentless inspector Javert.

Title: Jane Eyre
Author: Charlotte Brontë
Summary: An orphaned governess with a strong sense of self falls for her brooding employer, who hides a secret.
